In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
the static slice is more useful than the dynamic slice for the purpose of debugging, but that the dynamic slice is more useful for the purpose of testing.
dynamic slicing is the most effective technique for program debugging, and that static slicing is the most useful technique in program integration.
program slicing is a powerful tool for program understanding and program debugging, and it has been applied successfully in many areas of software engineering, especially program debugging.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
we have presented a unified framework to study and classify program slicing techniques.
the notion of execution slicing is a new notion that is a combination of static and dynamic slicing.
the static and dynamic slicing techniques are complementary, rather than alternative, approaches for program analysis and program understanding.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the notion of slicing is not unique, and the same name is used for different notions of slicing.
, for program slicing to be effective, it is necessary to consider a wide spectrum of slicing techniques, including static and dynamic slicing, and interprocedural as well as intraprocedural slicing.
, although the static and dynamic notions of program slicing have been studied separately in the literature, there is a strong connection between them.
